notes.title: I'm back! Our new game Dark Compass is now on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162762/3d338e6563073796b3b30dcbd7a5623dc8fbd067.png[/img]
Hi everyone, this is Blu (or Boss :P

This announcement is a bit sudden, but for good reason:
My new game [i][b]Dark Compass[/b][/i] is now on Steam!

Dark Compass is a multi-chapter psychological horror game.
You’ll journey through caves, dice tables, and holding the wheel of your fortune,
exploring the limits of will, obsession, and fear.

The Steam page is now up with some early screenshots and a short description.
More updates will follow soon — stay tuned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714090/_/

Thanks so much for all your support,
and if you’re interested, don’t forget to wishlist it ❤️

-DaydreaminBlu Studio

notes.title: 【You've received a New Message】English Localization Update
notes.content:
Dear Wanderer User,

Thanks to the hard work of our localizer @Max Ponoroff , Dreamline404 now features professionally localized English text for a smoother and more immersive experience.

You can now enjoy the game with better clarity and accuracy (no more awkward phrasing or strange wording) :p

We truly appreciate everyone who has played and supported the game so far. Your feedback has been truly invaluable. 

Meanwhile, we’ve been working on our new project [b][i]Dark Compass[/i][/b], hopefully we'll release the steam page soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162762/7a626ccfed2f1a10a5057d377bb94e42fd4454ce.png[/img]

notes.title: 【You've received a New Message】Notebook Feature & Translation Updates
notes.content:
Dear Wanderer User,

You can now use Dreamline404's built-in notepad to write down any information!

Or maybe, just draw something? :p

We've also fixed some of the translation errors in this update, and improved some of the translation to uplift quality of the text. Shout out to my friends who helped me a lot to find out those errors!

Anyway, thanks to our programmer Voidcatt who still worked in the New Year with me to make this interesting little feature.

We wish you all a happy New Year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162762/0a153c19a6649fd34fd53a7ebb705a55b0bda6d6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 【You received a new message】🔮Fun Facts About Dreamline 404 🔮
notes.content:
· All audio in [i]Dreamline 404[/i] was recorded by a handheld PDA from twenty years ago and then remixed on audio editor.

· I did most of the voice acting for the game ;p

· All the dreams in the Dream Hallway are real submissions, voiced by the submitters themselves, straight from their actual dreams.

· We’re working on the English version and the OST Album, hopefully they’ll be out soon! xD

· It seems like the Wanderer device might have the potential to install new apps or unlock new numbers in future updates.

· Rumor has it that people who share their Wanderer experiences at daydreaminblu_studio@outlook.com might get strange follow-up email from Dreamline Corp someday.

· Remember, Dreamline Service Center is your only friend on the dream journey.

· We are the Dreamline Service Center, Where all your dreams are not just your dreams :)
